steps.note: start from the default appearance, whatever an earlier run left
a title block and a text block, both on screen
steps.expression: (async () => { const id = decodeURIComponent(location.hash.split('/')[2]); const base = { kind: 'text', depth: 0, mediaPath: '', mediaName: '', plannedVisible: true, takeVisible: true, revealStep: null, collapsed: false }; const blocks = [{ ...base, key: 'k0', content: [{ text: 'Abertura do episódio' }], size: 'title', fontPx: 52 }, { ...base, key: 'k1', content: [{ text: 'Hoje vamos falar de filas' }], size: 'medium', fontPx: 30 }]; const response = await fetch('/api/rundowns/' + id + '/sheet', { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ blocks }) }); return response.status; })()

steps.note: the bar fades in over 150 ms
the bar above the focused text shows P, M, G and Título, the title is 52 px with a tight line height
steps.expression: (() => { const block = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sheet-block]'); const bar = block.querySelector('[data-testid=size-bar]'); const text = block.querySelector('[data-testid=block-text]'); const style = getComputedStyle(text); return [getComputedStyle(bar).opacity, [...bar.querySelectorAll('[role=radio]')].map((b) => b.textContent).join('|'), style.fontSize, style.lineHeight].join(' '); })()

steps.note: the title completes its height to the 44 px step, so the next block lands on the lines
a new size starts at its default
select 'vamos' in the second text (browser:run has no selection step); the format bar reacts to the real selectionchange
steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=block-text]')[1]; text.focus(); const range = document.createRange(); range.setStart(text.firstChild, 5); range.setEnd(text.firstChild, 10); const selection = getSelection(); selection.removeAllRanges(); selection.addRange(range); return selection.toString(); })()

steps.note: bold and red only on the passage
steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=block-text]')[1]; const red = text.querySelector('[data-color=red]'); return [text.textContent, text.querySelector('b').textContent, red.textContent, getComputedStyle(red).color, getComputedStyle(red).fontWeight].join('|'); })()

steps.note: formatting and the fine size persist on the server and after a reload
steps.expression: (async () => { const id = decodeURIComponent(location.hash.split('/')[2]); const sheet = await (await fetch('/api/rundowns/' + id + '/sheet')).json(); const text = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=block-text]')[1]; return JSON.stringify([sheet.blocks[0].size, sheet.blocks[0].fontPx, sheet.blocks[1].content, text.querySelector('b [data-color=red]')?.textContent]); })()

steps.note: the theme applies at once: page, sheet and the text colors
a pale accent on the light Porcelana sheet
choose an image in the panel's own file field (browser:run has no file step): a real PNG goes through POST /api/media
steps.expression: (() => { const bytes = new Uint8Array([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a, 0x70, 0x6e, 0x67]); const data = new DataTransfer(); data.items.add(new File([bytes], 'estudio.png', { type: 'image/png' })); const input = document.querySelector('[data-testid=background-image-input]'); input.files = data.files; const chosen = input.files.length; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return chosen; })()

steps.note: the image from the media folder paints the desk; the sheet keeps its veil
steps.expression: (async () => { const prefs = (await (await fetch('/api/preferences')).json()).preferences; const veil = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[data-testid=sheet-column]')).backgroundColor; return [prefs.theme, prefs.background.kind, getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundImage.includes('/api/media/'), /0\.9\)$/.test(veil.replace(/\s/g, ''))].join('|'); })()
